name: kodo_agent_review
notes: Started only by kodo-vsix's Settings → Agents 'Review with AI' action, through agent.run with the agent's name as its one prompt (doc/AGENT_BUILDER.md §5.3). `interactive: false` makes agent.run the only way onto it and locks its session, which is why it must also be non-selectable. Read-only: it holds validate_agent, report_agent_review and kodo_agent_critic, none of which writes a file. report_agent_review hands the verdict to the engine, which shows it and, on concerns, asks the user whether to open kodo_agent_builder on them in a new interactive session.
label: Agent Review
description: Reviews one of your agents against Kōdo's prompt-writing rules and lists each concern.
